description:
Who We Are

Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at verve.com.

Verve For Advertisers is a technology company that empowers brands and agencies to connect moments of discovery and drive measurable outcomes across screens.

As part of Verve, we've unified the company's demand-side offering, bringing together the largest on-site search intent dataset outside of walled gardens, direct SDK integrations with top apps, alongside data partnerships with 3M+ websites and LLMs. Our technology captures both what consumers do and why they do it, delivering high-fidelity audiences, insights, and activation across premium omnichannel inventory

What we're looking for

We are looking for an experienced Senior Machine Learning Engineer to take technical ownership of the ML systems powering our audience intelligence and advertising products.

You will design, develop, deploy and optimise production-grade machine learning solutions, including embedding-based audience models, multilingual intent classification, real-time prediction services and campaign performance optimisation.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role requiring strong technical judgement, architectural expertise and the ability to independently drive complex ML initiatives from initial experimentation through production deployment and ongoing optimisation.

You will contribute to the technical direction of our ML systems, establish engineering best practices and support the development of other engineers within the team.

What you’ll do

  • Own the end-to-end development of scalable machine learning systems, from problem definition and experimentation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
  • Design and optimise audience modelling solutions, including embeddings, lookalike models, similarity scoring, and intent and content classification using NLP, transformers and LLMs.
  • Evaluate emerging ML architectures and translate relevant research into practical, commercially valuable solutions.
  • Partner with campaign traders to investigate performance and delivery challenges and develop ML-driven solutions that improve advertising outcomes.
  • Architect and maintain low-latency inference services using Ray Serve and FastAPI, including invalid traffic (IVT) detection and traffic-quality models.
  • Develop scalable batch processing and feature engineering pipelines using Spark, Databricks and BigQuery.
  • Establish robust model lifecycle management practices using MLflow, including reproducible experimentation, model registries and controlled deployments.
  • Design and operate reliable, containerised ML services on Kubernetes.
  • Develop large-scale vector retrieval and similarity search solutions using PostgreSQL and pgvector.
  • Lead offline and online experimentation, including lift analysis, holdout validation and A/B testing, translating results into actionable product decisions.
  • Improve model performance, scalability, reliability and infrastructure cost efficiency.
  • Drive engineering best practices through architecture reviews, code reviews, automated testing and technical documentation.
  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to the team’s technical development.
  • Collaborate with product, data engineering and commercial teams across Europe and the US.

What you’ll need

  • Significant commercial experience in Machine Learning Engineering, with demonstrated ownership of ML models and systems operating in production.
  • Strong software engineering and system design skills, with the ability to architect scalable and maintainable ML solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Hands-on experience with PyTorch, scikit-learn and gradient-boosted models.
  • Strong experience with large-scale distributed data processing using PySpark.
  • Extensive practical experience with MLOps and model serving, including Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and MLflow.
  • Experience designing and operating ML workloads on AWS and/or GCP.
  • Strong understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including feature engineering, model evaluation, data leakage, bias and generalisation.
  • Experience troubleshooting, monitoring and optimising production ML systems.
  • Ability to independently make technical decisions and balance model performance, latency, reliability and cost.
  • Ability to deliver high-quality production software using AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code or similar agentic coding environments.
  • Experience contributing to technical design discussions, reviewing code and mentoring engineers.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work remotely with sufficient overlap with UK business hours.

Nice to have

  • AdTech experience, particularly audience modelling, identity resolution and programmatic advertising (DSPs and SSPs).
  • Experience with recommendation systems, semantic search and embedding-based retrieval.
  • Vector databases, approximate nearest neighbour (ANN) indexes and LLM fine-tuning.
  • Experience with Ray, Ray Serve, Databricks and Terraform.
  • Real-time data processing using Kafka or Flink.
  • GPU inference optimisation, including quantisation, batching and model compression.
  • Experience with load testing, observability and distributed system performance optimisation.
  • Privacy-aware machine learning, including GDPR, CCPA and sensitive-category classification.

We welcome diversity and non-traditional paths into all of our roles. We believe in hiring the right person as opposed to the right combination of keywords.

Communications regarding your application will only come from @jungroup.com or @verve.com email addresses.

Verve provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
